oxicloud-keeps-owner.reason: Upstream enforces this with a UNIQUE key; without it the property is false for states the database cannot reach.

rustfs-force-delete.reason: The port's (family, name) action pair is wider than upstream's enum; the precondition restricts to actions upstream can represent.

rustfs-resolution-terminates.reason: The property is termination, not success; chosen by the maintainer.

nora-glob-match.reason: gpt-6.1-sol proved the unconditional statement false in Lean: a pattern of Usize.max `*` bytes splits into Usize.max + 1 parts, more than a modeled Vec holds. Rust cannot allocate such a pattern.

nora-total.change: added: every role-rule pattern is shorter than Usize.max
nora-total.reason: Same capacity boundary as nora-glob-match, reached through `transition`; gpt-6.1-sol proved the unconditional statement false. Then also: namespace scopes (provider and rule) shorter than Usize.max; a scope of Usize.max `/` overflows its split (gpt-6.1-sol, 2026-10-10). Then also: the request namespace shorter than Usize.max; a namespace of Usize.max `/` overflows namespace_match's split (gpt-6.1-sol, 2026-10-10).

nora-middleware-total.change: added: every OIDC role-rule pattern in the config is shorter than Usize.max
nora-middleware-total.reason: Same capacity boundary as nora-glob-match, reached through the middleware's OIDC path; gpt-6.1-sol proved the unconditional statement false.

artifactkeeper-visibility-total.change: added: the request's path, query and header names and values are shorter than Usize.max
artifactkeeper-visibility-total.reason: gpt-6.1-sol proved the unconditional statement false: a Cookie header of Usize.max `;` splits into Usize.max + 1 parts, more than a modeled Vec holds. Rust cannot allocate such a request. Then the query bound became 2 * length < Usize.max: decoding a ticket of Usize.max/2+1 bytes of 0x80 doubles it (gpt-6.1-sol, 2026-10-10). Then also: permission rows list fewer than Usize.max actions in total; two rows with Usize.max + 1 distinct actions overflow their union (gpt-6.1-sol, 2026-10-10).

rustfs-bucket-total.change: added: bucket name at most 63 bytes and object key at most 1024 (S3's limits)
rustfs-bucket-total.reason: gpt-6.1-sol proved the unconditional statement false: a bucket name of Usize.max bytes makes building the resource ARN (`arn:aws:s3:::` + bucket + ...) exceed a Vec's capacity. S3 rejects such names before policy evaluation. Then also: each condition key's lookup name (name/variable) fits in a Vec; a key name of Usize.max bytes overflows when `/` is appended (gpt-6.1-sol, 2026-10-10). Then also: request condition values ≤ 8 KiB and statement resource patterns ≤ 20 KiB (S3's bucket policy limit): substituting a Usize.max-byte value into a resource pattern overflows, and the output grows with both, so neither side alone suffices (gpt-6.1-sol, 2026-10-10).

kanidm-effective-total.change: added: the search and modify profiles list fewer than Usize.max attributes and classes in total
kanidm-effective-total.reason: gpt-6.1-sol proved the unconditional statement false: two search profiles granting Usize.max + 1 distinct attributes overflow the union of their grants. Rust cannot hold that many distinct strings. Then sync agreements' attributes were added to the count: one agreement with Usize.max attributes overflows (gpt-6.1-sol, 2026-10-10). Then the bound reserves room for the 7 fixed attribute names the search modules add: Usize.max - 1 profile attributes plus class and displayname overflow (gpt-6.1-sol, 2026-10-10).

oxicloud-check-total.reason: gpt-6.1-sol proved the unconditional statement false: Usize.max groups containing one user expand to Usize.max + 1 IDs, more than a Vec holds. Then the bound leaves room for the user and the internal group: Usize.max - 1 membership rows still overflow (gpt-6.1-sol, 2026-10-10).

tuwunel-total.reason: gpt-6.1-sol proved the unconditional statement false: Usize.max self-relations overflow the relations walker's queue (docs/tuwunel-totality-obstruction.md). Then the bound became (n + 1)^4 < Usize.max: with recursion each yielded event adds a continuation and a child stream, and Usize.max - 1 self-relations still overflow the queue (gpt-6.1-sol, 2026-10-10).
